feature: Hover preview: rows yes, tiles no, tokens yes
note:
The five tile views (the deck's Card view, the collection grid, a set's grid, an open precon's Card view, the Consider tiles) draw no hover preview: the art on a tile is already about the size of one. A row that carries prose previews on its name and thumbnail only. Token rows preview on their image and name, and card details opened from one page through the deck's tokens. A sheet shows each surface's layout, which is what the change must not move; the hover itself is `pnpm probe:hover-rows` and `pnpm probe:cuts-panel`, because a contact sheet photographs a resting page.

PRECONDITIONS: the account's About row is cleared (`pnpm probe:hover-rows` does it), `DECK_TOKENS_ENABLED` and `PRECONS_ENABLED` are on in the server, and the database holds the token catalog (a scratch branch of staging after `pull:staging`). `HOVER_ROWS_DECK` is any deck of the account that makes two or more tokens.

rows.label: /decks/[id] — the Tokens group, image and name previewing
/decks/[id] — card view, tiles with no hover
/collection — the grid, tiles with no hover
/collection/sets/[code] — the set grid, cells with no hover
/decks/precons/[fileName] — card view, tiles with no hover
